b:
For a long time now
others have not liked
me sleeping

In my school days
Amma
would come again and again
to wake me

When I went to the village
for a rest,
a rooster
would chase me
without a break

At university
I have no memory
of ever
lying down

Today
I have sold
my sleep

One day
I will sleep

Even if the whole village
calls me lovingly,
that day I will not
get up for anyone
